acceptance_criteria.criterion: Documentation reflects a multi-tenant gastronomy SaaS with menu mgmt, ordering, secure payments, analytics, ratings, RBAC
acceptance_criteria.evidence: product-vision.md items 1-12 map 1:1 onto epics 1-12 in mvp-scope.md; domain-boundaries.md defines a module per capability

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every step of the MVP acceptance scenario (mvp-scope.md) has backing tickets
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No ticket covers transactional order-confirmation email or a VAT/tax model, though both are required by the scenario and referenced elsewhere in the docs

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Stack choice is coherent and ADR-0001 reasoning is sound
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ADR-0001 records real alternatives with concrete rejection reasons; Cloudflare-over-Vercel is justified by the commercial-use ToS restriction

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Two-layer tenant isolation is sufficient and consistent across rules and tickets
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Guest checkout (cart/order/rating) has no membership; neither documented layer defined that path before this review

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Payment design never trusts client totals, gates on verified webhooks, stays test-mode-only
acceptance_criteria.evidence: payments.md + ticket 24/25 acceptance criteria close the client-total and client-redirect holes explicitly

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Threat model has no material gaps for this domain
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No MFA path for Owner/Manager accounts controlling Stripe payouts/refunds

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 39 tickets are logically sequenced with sensible dependencies
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Cross-tenant harness (ticket 5) sequenced before auth (ticket 7) it would need; analytics_events referenced before its creating ticket

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Nothing materially over-engineered for an MVP
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Epic 12 correctly phase:post-mvp; non-goals.md and domain-boundaries.md both forbid pre-building unneeded tables

review_findings_summary: 12 findings (1 critical, 4 high, 5 medium, 2 low). Critical: guest-path tenant isolation undefined. High: missing transactional-email ticket, missing tax/VAT model, undefined Stripe Connect account/charge topology, no MVP-phase imprint/privacy ticket. See docs/decisions/assumptions.md for what was fixed immediately vs. deferred as ticket-level follow-up.
fixes_applied_this_pass: docs/security/tenant-isolation.md + .claude/rules/tenant-isolation.md: added Layer 0 (unauthenticated/guest path isolation model)
docs/architecture/adr/0002-stripe-connect-account-model.md: recorded Express + destination-charge decision with liability consequences
docs/operations/deployment-strategy.md + docs/platform/service-register.md: resolved the free-tier backups contradiction via a Cloudflare R2 pg_dump job
.claude/rules/payments.md: added amount-mismatch handling and awaiting_payment expiry
docs/security/threat-model.md + docs/decisions/assumptions.md: recorded MFA as an explicit accepted risk for MVP, not silently dropped
deferred_as_ticket_followups: Fix ticket #4 wording: 'exactly one Owner' -> 'at least one Owner'
Add a transactional-email ticket (Resend order confirmation/status change)
Add an MVP-phase imprint/privacy/consent ticket to Epic 5
Re-sequence ticket #5 (cross-tenant harness) to not depend on ticket #7 (auth)
Move analytics_events table creation earlier than ticket #31
Seed packages/ui design tokens in ticket #1
Mark ticket #39 blocked on a real integration partner
residual_risks: Supabase free tier pauses after 7 days idle and has no built-in backups (mitigated via the new R2 job, but the restore path is untested until Epic 11)
@opennextjs/cloudflare is a community adapter — raw-body handling for Stripe webhook signature verification on Workers must be proven in ticket 25
Cloudflare Workers free tier caps at 100,000 requests/day
Resend free tier caps at 100 emails/day
Sentry free tier allows only 1 dashboard user
Dispute/chargeback handling, penetration testing, GDPR Art. 30 records, and vendor DPAs remain unassessed
required_actions_before_next_epic_start: Apply the 7 deferred ticket-level fixes above before Epic 3/4/5/6/7/12 tickets are picked up, respectively
